headings.text: Does PandoCore replace my firewall, WAF or scanner?
headings.body: No. PandoCore focuses specifically on runtime execution integrity, which means issues that appear while code is running. Use it alongside your existing preventive measures.

PandoCore supports Kubernetes 1.25 and later. It has been tested on: GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) kind (local development) minikube (local development) EKS and AKS support is expected but not yet validated.
